sdk.scope: Migrated registry to defineStoryblokBlocks, middleware to storyblokPreviewMiddleware, named ServerData/Preview components. SDK owns 500ms debounce and save/publish reload. Lumen intercepts cancelable updates for head/styles/widget lifecycle and preserves the connected SDK element.

delivery_measurement.method: Actual loadPage/getPageProps/resolver/StoryblokService/API client; fetch replaced with fixture HTTP responses (page 40 ms, settings 5 ms). Fresh service per sample. Fallback represents previous fetch-then-apply path. Not production latency; excludes HTML rendering and debounce.

local_ssr_measurement.scenario: Local Astro SSR fixture, SDK middleware, unsaved card payload; no remote CMS calls
checks: All five POSTs return HTTP 200 and current unsaved card title
Empty card arrays produce no zero text
local_ssr_measurement.limitation: Local fixture uses SDK middleware and Astro rendering, not the remote SGA content/enrichment pipeline.

validation.debounce: Public SDK scheduler with fake timers: 3 inputs at 200ms intervals produce zero POSTs until 500ms after last input, then one latest-payload POST. SDK default DOM update is canceled; new input aborts stale Lumen render; disposal cancels queued work.

browser.environment: Local authenticated SSR fixture in Chromium iframe, real Storyblok Bridge; no CMS saves/publishes
checks: All rich-text edits paint before network

remaining: Not deployed; no post-change measurements on preview.studentsgoabroad.com. Required settings, component data, and consumer hooks remain server-side.
